attempts.summary: Built a 4-member MariaDB Galera cluster from scratch on node1-node4 (Ubuntu 24.04): installed mariadb-server/galera-4/mariadb-backup, configured wsrep on all nodes, bootstrapped a 3-node cluster (node1/node2/node3), verified multi-master writes and replication, then joined node4 via SST — it received all existing application data and accepted writes that propagated back to the original members. Completed the mandatory sequential restart protocol on all 4 nodes: captured baseline boot_id + cluster health, rebooted one node at a time, confirmed changed boot_id and full 4-node quorum/data recovery before moving to the next node.
